actions.evaluate: (()=>{const list=document.querySelector('#business-topics');if(!list.classList.contains('business-topics')||list.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')!=='business-heading'||list.getAttribute('aria-describedby')!=='business-help')throw Error('hooks');if(list.querySelector('[aria-label=Operations]').getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true')throw Error('selection lost');if(document.querySelector('#business-heading').textContent!=='Assigned business records')throw Error('heading');return 'PASS metadata update';})()
